turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Before you say anything else, tell me who decided that, and on what basis.
I don't think this is productive.
"Productive." My son got a zero without anyone calling home, so tell me who decided it and on what basis.
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
You asked for this meeting, Hale. If you walk out without answering who decided that zero and on what basis, I'm going straight to the principal's office from here.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.

I won't be emailing anyone, Hale; I'll be standing in the principal's office in five minutes. You entered a zero before calling me, against your own school's procedure, and I'm writing down that you refused to tell me who decided it. The zero comes off, or this goes to the board.
